Role reports to:

Finance Transformation Sr. Manager, SDI

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

The Sr. Financial Analyst role is pivotal in supporting our teams with financial reporting, tool development, analysis, and process management for transformation initiatives, with strong focus on Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) activities. This role will be responsible for delivering financial support to various business functions.

Main Responsibilities

  • Trusted Business Partnering: Collaborate with business partners across the organization, providing financial insights, education, and support to drive informed business decisions.

  • Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare, analyze, and present financial reports and metrics related to transformation initiatives, including variance analysis, financial forecasts, and budget tracking for projects on a quarterly and ad hoc basis.

  • Tool Development & Maintenance: Develop and maintain tools and models to support FP&A activities such as resource planning, value case tracking, and monthly budget management.

  • Business Plan, Forecast Cycles & Long-Range Financial Planning (LRFP): Collaborate with project teams to update and maintain business plans, forecast cycles, and LRFP, ensuring alignment with transformation goals and financial targets.

  • Budget & Value Delivery Tracking: Track and report on budgets and value delivery across a portfolio of projects, including resource movements, spend, savings, technology savings, and headcount.

  • SOX Controls: Support compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls and regulations, particularly related to financial reporting and data integrity.

  • Technical Accounting & Financial Compliance: Ensure accurate reflection of actuals into different financial statements while partnering closely with Financial Compliance, Technical Accounting, and Tech & Data business partners. Support testing and audits as needed.

  • Process Improvement & Innovation: Identify opportunities to enhance financial processes, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and innovative solutions.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or Accounting.

  • Experience in Finance, operations, or related business

  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, along with advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, formulas, VLOOKUP, etc.).

  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and present findings to stakeholders.

  • Ability to work well in a dynamic environment, recommending and implementing process improvements, working independently, and managing multiple tasks.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and organizational skills.

  • Fluent English proficiency.

Desired Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant financial certifications.

  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and other financial reporting software.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Role reports to:

Finance Transformation Sr. Manager, SDI

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

The Financial Analyst role is pivotal in supporting our teams with financial reporting, tool development, analysis, and process management for transformation initiatives, with a strong focus on Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) activities. This position is responsible for providing financial support to various business functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Trusted Business Partnering: Collaborate with business partners across the organization, providing financial insights, education, and support to drive informed business decisions.

  • Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare, analyze, and present financial reports and metrics related to transformation initiatives, including variance analysis, financial forecasts, and quarterly and ad hoc project budget tracking.

  • Tool Development & Maintenance: Develop and maintain tools and models to support FP&A activities, such as resource planning, value case tracking, and monthly budget management.

  • Business Plan, Forecast Cycles & Long-Range Financial Planning (LRFP): Work with project teams to update and maintain business plans, forecast cycles, and LRFP, ensuring alignment with transformation objectives and financial targets.

  • Budget & Value Delivery Tracking: Track and report on budgets and value delivery across a portfolio of projects, including resource movements, spending, savings (including technology savings), and headcount.

  • SOX Controls: Support compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls and regulations, particularly those related to financial reporting and data integrity.

  • Technical Accounting & Financial Compliance: Ensure accurate reflection of actuals in financial statements, partnering closely with Financial Compliance, Technical Accounting, and Tech & Data teams. Support testing and audits as required.

What We Are Looking For Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or Accounting.

  • Experience in finance, operations, or related business areas.

  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency (PivotTables, formulas, VLOOKUP, etc.).

  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and effectively present findings to stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and solid organizational skills.

  • Fluent English proficiency.

Desired Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other financial certifications (preferred).

  • Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP and other financial reporting software.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Role reports to:

Finance Transformation Sr. Manager, SDI

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

The Finance Supervisor role is pivotal in supporting our teams with financial reporting, tool development, analysis, and process management for transformation initiatives, with a strong focus on Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) activities. This role will be responsible for providing financial support across multiple business functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Trusted Business Partnering: Collaborate with business partners across the organization, providing financial insights, education, and support to drive informed business decisions.

  • Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare, analyze, and present financial reports and metrics related to transformation initiatives, including variance analysis, financial forecasts, and quarterly and ad hoc budget tracking for projects.

  • Tool Development & Maintenance: Develop and maintain tools and models to support FP&A activities such as resource planning, value case tracking, and monthly budget management.

  • Business Plan, Forecast Cycles & Long-Range Financial Planning (LRFP): Work with project teams to update and maintain business plans, forecast cycles, and LRFP, ensuring alignment with transformation goals and financial targets.

  • Budget & Value Delivery Tracking: Track and report on budgets and value delivery across a portfolio of projects, including resource movements, spending, savings, technology savings, and headcount.

  • SOX Controls: Assist in ensuring compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls and regulations, particularly those related to financial reporting and data integrity.

  • Technical Accounting & Financial Compliance: Ensure accurate reflection of actuals across financial statements while partnering closely with Financial Compliance, Technical Accounting, and Tech & Data teams. Support testing and audits as needed.

  • Process Improvement & Innovation: Identify opportunities to enhance financial processes, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and the integration of innovative solutions.

  • People Management (Optional): This role may include leadership and people management responsibilities, depending on business needs.

What We Are Looking For Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or Accounting.
  • Solid experience in finance, operations, or related business areas.
  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency (PivotTables, formulas, VLOOKUP, etc.).
  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and communicate insights effectively to stakeholders.
  • Ability to work well in a dynamic environment, recommend and implement process improvements, work independently, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and solid organizational abilities.
  • Fluent English proficiency.
Desired Qualifications
  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other financial certifications (preferred).
  • Familiarity with ERP systems, such as SAP, and other financial reporting software.

Role reports to:

Finance Transformation Sr. Manager, SDI

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

The Sr. Financial Analyst role is pivotal in supporting our teams with financial reporting, tool development, analysis, and process management for transformation initiatives, with strong focus on Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) activities. This role will be responsible for delivering financial support to various business functions.

Main Responsibilities

  • Trusted Business Partnering: Collaborate with business partners across the organization, providing financial insights, education, and support to drive informed business decisions.

  • Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare, analyze, and present financial reports and metrics related to transformation initiatives, including variance analysis, financial forecasts, and budget tracking for projects on a quarterly and ad hoc basis.

  • Tool Development & Maintenance: Develop and maintain tools and models to support FP&A activities such as resource planning, value case tracking, and monthly budget management.

  • Business Plan, Forecast Cycles & Long-Range Financial Planning (LRFP): Collaborate with project teams to update and maintain business plans, forecast cycles, and LRFP, ensuring alignment with transformation goals and financial targets.

  • Budget & Value Delivery Tracking: Track and report on budgets and value delivery across a portfolio of projects, including resource movements, spend, savings, technology savings, and headcount.

  • SOX Controls: Support compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls and regulations, particularly related to financial reporting and data integrity.

  • Technical Accounting & Financial Compliance: Ensure accurate reflection of actuals into different financial statements while partnering closely with Financial Compliance, Technical Accounting, and Tech & Data business partners. Support testing and audits as needed.

  • Process Improvement & Innovation: Identify opportunities to enhance financial processes, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and innovative solutions.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or Accounting.

  • Experience in Finance, operations, or related business

  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, along with advanced Excel skills (PivotTables, formulas, VLOOKUP, etc.).

  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and present findings to stakeholders.

  • Ability to work well in a dynamic environment, recommending and implementing process improvements, working independently, and managing multiple tasks.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and organizational skills.

  • Fluent English proficiency.

Desired Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant financial certifications.

  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and other financial reporting software.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

What you will do

Responsável por um grupo de médicos e PDVs dentro de uma área de negócios, nas dimensões de: Resultados de vendas (prescrição e sell-out).

O responsável por esta vaga deverá efetuar visitação médica promovendo todos os produtos relativos à sua grade de trabalho, além de visitação periódica a PDVs buscando informações sobre preços, promoções e faltas de produtos. Será responsável no atendimento dos HCPs na região de Recife, Garanhuns e Caruaru/PE

Principais responsabilidades

  • Garantir a responsabilidade integral do território: negócio (prescrição e sell-out), execução no HCP (médicos) e relacionamento com os clientes.

  • Garantir a cobertura de visitação médica de acordo com a necessidade informada pela sua gerência distrital.

  • Executar as estratégias de comunicação das marcas nos HCP´s para garantir a demanda dos produtos em seu território, desde a utilização correta do Visual AID até a execução dos eventos médicos.

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de Vendas/Trade e POS-Force para identificação de oportunidades de aumento de demanda, positivação e faseamento de produtos KENVUE.

  • Ser responsável pela execução no HCP, garantido a implementação dos objetivos de frequência e sequência, cadastro e programas com médicos.

  • Disseminar a cultura KENVUE junto aos seus pares, colaboradores e clientes.

  • Garantir que as obrigações burocráticas e processos sejam executados com disciplina e excelência (rituais e rotinas de campo).

Finance Transformation Sr. Manager, SDI

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

The Financial Analyst role is pivotal in supporting our teams with financial reporting, tool development, analysis, and process management for transformation initiatives, with a strong focus on Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) activities. This position is responsible for providing financial support to various business functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Trusted Business Partnering: Collaborate with business partners across the organization, providing financial insights, education, and support to drive informed business decisions.

  • Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare, analyze, and present financial reports and metrics related to transformation initiatives, including variance analysis, financial forecasts, and quarterly and ad hoc project budget tracking.

  • Tool Development & Maintenance: Develop and maintain tools and models to support FP&A activities, such as resource planning, value case tracking, and monthly budget management.

  • Business Plan, Forecast Cycles & Long-Range Financial Planning (LRFP): Work with project teams to update and maintain business plans, forecast cycles, and LRFP, ensuring alignment with transformation objectives and financial targets.

  • Budget & Value Delivery Tracking: Track and report on budgets and value delivery across a portfolio of projects, including resource movements, spending, savings (including technology savings), and headcount.

  • SOX Controls: Support compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls and regulations, particularly those related to financial reporting and data integrity.

  • Technical Accounting & Financial Compliance: Ensure accurate reflection of actuals in financial statements, partnering closely with Financial Compliance, Technical Accounting, and Tech & Data teams. Support testing and audits as required.

What We Are Looking For Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or Accounting.

  • Experience in finance, operations, or related business areas.

  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency (PivotTables, formulas, VLOOKUP, etc.).

  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and effectively present findings to stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and solid organizational skills.

  • Fluent English proficiency.

Desired Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other financial certifications (preferred).

  • Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP and other financial reporting software.

O Representante de Vendas Jr. – Transfer Farma é responsável pelo desenvolvimento dos principais clientes farma do canal indireto na região, assegurando a execução da estratégia da companhia no ponto de venda.   • Ensino superior cursando (com formação em até 6 meses) ou concluído.

Na Kenvue, todas as nossas vagas já são abertas para todas as pessoas! Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente inclusivo e acolhemos candidaturas de quem quer fazer parte da nossa jornada de cuidado diário.

Ao se inscrever aqui, você entra para a nossa Comunidade de Talentos Para Pessoas Com Deficiência, e o nosso time de Recrutamento entrará em contato com você sempre que existirem vagas alinhadas às suas experiências, interesses e objetivos de carreira.

Finance Transformation Sr. Manager, SDI

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

The Financial Analyst role is pivotal in supporting our teams with financial reporting, tool development, analysis, and process management for transformation initiatives, with a strong focus on Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) activities. This position is responsible for providing financial support to various business functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Trusted Business Partnering: Collaborate with business partners across the organization, providing financial insights, education, and support to drive informed business decisions.

  • Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare, analyze, and present financial reports and metrics related to transformation initiatives, including variance analysis, financial forecasts, and quarterly and ad hoc project budget tracking.

  • Tool Development & Maintenance: Develop and maintain tools and models to support FP&A activities, such as resource planning, value case tracking, and monthly budget management.

  • Business Plan, Forecast Cycles & Long-Range Financial Planning (LRFP): Work with project teams to update and maintain business plans, forecast cycles, and LRFP, ensuring alignment with transformation objectives and financial targets.

  • Budget & Value Delivery Tracking: Track and report on budgets and value delivery across a portfolio of projects, including resource movements, spending, savings (including technology savings), and headcount.

  • SOX Controls: Support compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls and regulations, particularly those related to financial reporting and data integrity.

  • Technical Accounting & Financial Compliance: Ensure accurate reflection of actuals in financial statements, partnering closely with Financial Compliance, Technical Accounting, and Tech & Data teams. Support testing and audits as required.

What We Are Looking For Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or Accounting.

  • Experience in finance, operations, or related business areas.

  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency (PivotTables, formulas, VLOOKUP, etc.).

  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and effectively present findings to stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and solid organizational skills.

  • Fluent English proficiency.

Desired Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other financial certifications (preferred).

  • Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP and other financial reporting software.

  • Assegurar disciplina e excelência na execução dos processos da Unidade de Negócios (rituais e rotinas de campo).
  • Demonstrar espírito de dono, foco em rentabilidade e forte orientação a resultados.

  • Ensino superior cursando (com formação em até 6 meses) ou concluído.

Role reports to:

Finance Transformation Sr. Manager, SDI

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

The Finance Supervisor role is pivotal in supporting our teams with financial reporting, tool development, analysis, and process management for transformation initiatives, with a strong focus on Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) activities. This role will be responsible for providing financial support across multiple business functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Trusted Business Partnering: Collaborate with business partners across the organization, providing financial insights, education, and support to drive informed business decisions.

  • Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare, analyze, and present financial reports and metrics related to transformation initiatives, including variance analysis, financial forecasts, and quarterly and ad hoc budget tracking for projects.

  • Tool Development & Maintenance: Develop and maintain tools and models to support FP&A activities such as resource planning, value case tracking, and monthly budget management.

  • Business Plan, Forecast Cycles & Long-Range Financial Planning (LRFP): Work with project teams to update and maintain business plans, forecast cycles, and LRFP, ensuring alignment with transformation goals and financial targets.

  • Budget & Value Delivery Tracking: Track and report on budgets and value delivery across a portfolio of projects, including resource movements, spending, savings, technology savings, and headcount.

  • SOX Controls: Assist in ensuring compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls and regulations, particularly those related to financial reporting and data integrity.

  • Technical Accounting & Financial Compliance: Ensure accurate reflection of actuals across financial statements while partnering closely with Financial Compliance, Technical Accounting, and Tech & Data teams. Support testing and audits as needed.

  • Process Improvement & Innovation: Identify opportunities to enhance financial processes, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and the integration of innovative solutions.

  • People Management (Optional): This role may include leadership and people management responsibilities, depending on business needs.

What We Are Looking For Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or Accounting.
  • Solid experience in finance, operations, or related business areas.
  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency (PivotTables, formulas, VLOOKUP, etc.).
  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and communicate insights effectively to stakeholders.
  • Ability to work well in a dynamic environment, recommend and implement process improvements, work independently, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and solid organizational abilities.
  • Fluent English proficiency.
Desired Qualifications
  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other financial certifications (preferred).
  • Familiarity with ERP systems, such as SAP, and other financial reporting software.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Role reports to:

Finance Transformation Sr. Manager, SDI

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

The Financial Analyst role is pivotal in supporting our teams with financial reporting, tool development, analysis, and process management for transformation initiatives, with a strong focus on Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) activities. This position is responsible for providing financial support to various business functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Trusted Business Partnering: Collaborate with business partners across the organization, providing financial insights, education, and support to drive informed business decisions.

  • Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare, analyze, and present financial reports and metrics related to transformation initiatives, including variance analysis, financial forecasts, and quarterly and ad hoc project budget tracking.

  • Tool Development & Maintenance: Develop and maintain tools and models to support FP&A activities, such as resource planning, value case tracking, and monthly budget management.

  • Business Plan, Forecast Cycles & Long-Range Financial Planning (LRFP): Work with project teams to update and maintain business plans, forecast cycles, and LRFP, ensuring alignment with transformation objectives and financial targets.

  • Budget & Value Delivery Tracking: Track and report on budgets and value delivery across a portfolio of projects, including resource movements, spending, savings (including technology savings), and headcount.

  • SOX Controls: Support compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls and regulations, particularly those related to financial reporting and data integrity.

  • Technical Accounting & Financial Compliance: Ensure accurate reflection of actuals in financial statements, partnering closely with Financial Compliance, Technical Accounting, and Tech & Data teams. Support testing and audits as required.

What We Are Looking For Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or Accounting.

  • Experience in finance, operations, or related business areas.

  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency (PivotTables, formulas, VLOOKUP, etc.).

  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and effectively present findings to stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and solid organizational skills.

  • Fluent English proficiency.

Desired Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other financial certifications (preferred).

  • Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP and other financial reporting software.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

title: Camunda 8 Developer
description:
Corus Consulting is a consulting firm with more than 15 years of experience with different clients worldwide; we have presence in Europe, United States, Asia and Mexico.

We are looking for your talent to work as:


Camunda 8 Developer


About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Camunda Developer with knowledge in the 8th version, to join our team supporting a customer in the banking sector.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop new components, maintain and evolve existent ones according to the team priorities and product roadmap.
  • Active role on team software quality assurance, best practices and agile methodology.
  • Take responsibility of the software delivery by ensuring quality and scope expectations are met.
  • Work closely with partner technology teams and collaborate effectively.


Requirements:

  • Hand-on experience designing and implementing Camunda 8 BPMN processes.
  • Deep understanding of Java (11 or above) and Java Spring (4 or superior) and solid understanding of OO principles.
  • Solid experience Spring Boot.
  • Diligent with automated testing i.e. JUnit/Mockito/Cucumber, etc.
  • Understanding of RESTful API principles.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B2).


Location:

  • Remote from Brazil.


Ready to bring your expertise to the next level? Apply now and join a team that's shaping the future of financial services.


Support the team and the Camunda Chapter!

title: Legal Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!



⚠️Important Application Notice

Please select only the role that best aligns with your experience. We will only review your first application. If you apply to multiple positions on LinkedIn, additional submissions will not be processed and may cause your application to be overlooked.

title: Gerente Distrital de Vendas
description:
Job Description


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente Distrital de Vendas.


Você se identifica com ambiente dinâmico, com empresas em momento de startup que proporcionam alto potencial de crescimento profissional?


Estamos em busca de Pessoas Campeãs que queiram se desafiar e estar conosco para alçar voos cada vez mais altos!


Responsabilidades:


  • Liderando um time direto, fica responsável pelos Canais de Distribuição, Redes e Território (Canal Independente)
  • Responsável pelo desenvolvimento das capacidades funcionais e competências do time, através das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela cia;
  • Ser corresponsável na definição de um GTM de vendas otimizada, eficiente e rentável para o cumprimento dos objetivos traçados; Identificando lacunas nas áreas de cobertura dentro do território e avaliando oportunidades de investimento em cobertura. (Gestão de White Space);
  • Gerir Sell In, Sell Out, Estoques e política comercial dos Canais de Redes e Distribuição;
  • Implementar, acompanhar e apoiar os planos (JBPs) dos parceiros de Distribuição e Redes;
  • Redes: Implementar, acompanhar e Liderar as estratégias dos trimestres para a ativação do portfólio de marcas em coordenando a execução das equipes de Venda incluindo política de varejo, planos de clientes por UF, DOH da UF;
  • Assegurar a execução do plano de ativação em linha com o orçamento, atuando rapidamente no caso de ações corretivas e influenciando todas as áreas envolvidas no alcance dos resultados;
  • Canal Independente (Território): Desenvolver, o canal do varejo independente através de um time de 2 gestores e mais de 20 executivos, buscando atingir a melhor distribuição numérica, faturamento, mix e evolução dos itens prioritários (lançamentos);


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior Completo (Cursos de exatas: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm e etc.,);
  • Pós graduação (Diferencial)
  • Experiência Comercial (Indústrias de bens de consumo - indispensável);
  • Experiência em liderança de times comerciais (indispensável);
  • Experiência no Canal indireto Distribuição FMCG (indispensável).


Informações adicionais:


Benefícios:


  • Plano Médico e Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Ticket Refeição;
  • Veículo;
  • Cartão combustível
  • PPR


Buscamos pessoas que querem colocar a mão na massa e fazer acontecer para tornar as empresas do Grupo referência em inovação e no cuidado com as pessoas. Vem ser Grupo NC você também!


SOMOS LEGRAND


Há mais de 40 anos no mercado farmacêutico, o Legrand Pharma está entre os 15 maiores laboratórios do país (unidades). Com um amplo portfólio de produtos (mais de 300 apresentações), atua no segmento de OTCs, tarjados e genéricos, presente em mais de 90% das farmácias brasileiras com forte atuação nas categorias de tosse, gastrointestinal, vitaminas, dermatológicos e saúde feminina.

title: Senior Technical Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Analyst with minimum 7 years of experience with Solaris/AIX/Linux, WebSphere, WebLogic or JBoss and various middleware infrastructure technologies.


Responsibilities:


· Evaluate, design, document, install, test, implement, monitors and maintain complex UNIX/Linux based applications such as GPP, GCP, Total Payments, and infrastructure solutions

· Configuring and support of production, testing and development environments (Solaris/AIX/Linux)

· Troubleshooting, Preparing, updating, and maintaining technical documentation and RFPs

· Capacity planning, DR configuration, and High Availability implementation and testing

· Evaluate, recommend, installs and configure tools for event monitoring, capacity planning, performance monitoring on UNIX/Linux systems providing automated 24/7 production application and system monitoring

· Conduct technical training


Must-Have Skills:


· Relevant academic background

· Good understanding of GPP SP & Total Payments deployment architecture

· Minimum 7 years of technical work experience on UNIX/Linux/Cloud environment. This could include development, technical QA, and application implementation/support

· Systems troubleshooting and resolution of system and application problems

· Excellent customer facing, communication and interpersonal skills

· Experience with the following:

o J2EE Application Servers – WebSphere / WebLogic / JBoss (including performance benchmark analysis)

o Microsoft Azure or Amazon EC2

o Hazelcast

o Oracle DB (including performance benchmark analysis)

o IBM MQ

o UNIX Shell or Perl Scripting and/or Web Application Server scripting

o Elastic Search

o Kafka (a plus)

o Understanding of UNIX high availability and clustering

· 50% overlap with US hours to support offshore client

· Extensive travel might be required


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 40 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Part-time | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Formulate business development plans, assist the team in completing the introduction, negotiation, cooperation, and signing of business cooperation projects
  • Contact, negotiate, and close profitable deals with potential KOLs
  • Support KOL and design special campaigns to increase KOL trading volume
  • Build partnerships with KOLs or crypto projects, and promote cooperation with each other
  • Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs
  • Build long-term relationships with new and existing KOL/clients


Requirements


  • Open to fresh graduates or part-time Business Development
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and passionate about achieving results
  • A good understanding of crypto markets is a plus
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese is essential


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Senior Kotlin Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a Senior Kotlin Software Engineer to join our team. You’ll design, build, and maintain backend services that power our applications, working closely with frontend and product teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure APIs.


What you will do :

  • Design and implement backend services using Kotlin and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by our applications.
  • Work with PostgreSQL databases, ensuring performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with product, frontend, and QA teams to deliver high-quality features.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following best practices.
  • Contribute to system design and architecture discussions.


What we expect from you:

  • 5 years of experience in software engineering.
  • Deep expertise with Kotlin and Spring Boot, including complex system design.
  • Proven experience designing scalable backend architectures.
  • Strong focus on performance, security, and reliability.
  • Ability to mentor junior/mid engineers and lead technical initiatives.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability practices.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Full Stack Sênior - Node/TypeScript(React)
description:
Sobre a TIVIT | Seu futuro, nosso desafio


A TIVIT é uma multinacional brasileira e one-stop-shop de tecnologia, presente no mercado há 20 anos e com operação em dez países da América Latina. Por meio de quatro unidades de negócios: Digital Business , Cloud Solutions, CyberSecurity e Technology Platforms , a empresa oferece respostas personalizadas e soluções que impactam nos negócios, e na rotina de empresas e pessoas.

A companhia conta com uma forte estratégia de inovação, com o TIVIT Labs (hub que apoia as empresas a descobrirem e solucionarem os seus maiores desafios de inovação) e a TIVIT Ventures, braço de aquisição de empresas inovadoras, que já conta com as marcas Stone Age, tbankS, Privally, DevApi, Lambda3, SENSR.IT e XMS.


Entregar valor para as empresas que trabalham conosco é um esforço que exige uma constante coordenação entre todas as partes da TIVIT. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma empresa que entrega serviços e produtos de ponta-a-ponta (da proposta, passando por todo ciclo de vida, à entrega), por isso, ao trabalhar conosco você vai ter contato com profissionais que possuem diversas experiências em projetos e clientes variados


Descrição da posição Full Stack (Node.js/Typescript) - Sênior

  • 100% Remoto / Contratação CLT
  • Buscamos uma pessoa que possua perfil de liderança, com pelo menos 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, que será referência técnica dentro do time de projeto e apoiará no dia a dia no contato com o cliente. Além disso, esta pessoa precisa estar disposta a aprender e ensinar em todos os momentos, sair da zona de conforto e que possam contribuir com times auto gerenciáveis.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar desde a ideação e concepção de produtos e serviços, até sua entrega e sustentação;
  • Fazer escolhas e/ou discussões das tecnologias que serão empregadas em projetos;
  • Participar e contribuir com projetos que utilizam metodologias de entrega ágil, integração contínua e desenvolvimento guiado por testes (TDD ), comportamento (BDD ), técnicas de modelagem e pair programming;
  • Contribuir com a evolução dos nossos projetos sendo parte de um time de alta performance que atua diretamente com empresas de relevância nacional e internacional.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior completo ;
  • Perfil com foco em BackEnd
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento utilizando NodeJS com NestJS;
  • Experiência com Javascript e Typescript (mais Typescript do que JS puro);
  • Sólido conhecimento em JavaScript, HTML, CSS e princípios de desenvolvimento front-end.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento guiado por testes (TDD ) e comportamento (BDD )
  • Capacidade de criar componentes reutilizáveis e manter código limpo e escalável.
  • Experiência com React.js ;
  • Experiência com Azure Cloud;
  • Container Apps;
  • Function Apps;
  • Observabilidade com Service Bus;
  • Event Hub;
  • Blob Storage;
  • Azure Cosmos Db (Mongo Db);
  • Azure Database (PostgresSQL);
  • Azure DevOps;
  • Azure Pipelines (para CI/CD);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD
  • ELK (monitoramento);
  • Elasticsearch;
  • APM;
  • Prática com estratégias de branch
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura limpa e/ou arquitetura hexagonal
  • Experiência com SOLID
  • Experiência com Microservices
  • Mensageria (Kafka,RabbitMQ );
  • Git;


Experiências técnicas desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Padrões/design de Software
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e bibliotecas relacionadas, como React Router, Material-UI, ou Styled Components,


O que oferecemos para você?

✔Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

✔Assistência médica e Odontológica;

✔Convênio Farmácia (descontos na compra de medicamentos);

✔Seguro de Vida;

✔Convênio Academia;

✔TIVIT Club (descontos e parcerias com as melhores lojas);

✔PAC - Programa de aceleração de carreira;

✔Reembolso para certificações;

✔MOBIFLIX – Nossa academia corporativa tem cursos presenciais e online, alinhados as novas tendências do mercado de tecnologia;

✔Plataforma online de crédito consignado, a TIVIT te ajuda a realizar os seus objetivos pessoais como reforma no seu apê/casa, financiar estudos e quitar dívidas, de acordo com as regras e políticas da cia;

✔Programa de Apoio Pessoal com orientação psicológica, financeira e jurídica em parceria com a Alelo.


Acreditamos que o presente é plural e a inclusão transforma, por isso, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas em nossas vagas, para promovermos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, de respeito, justiça e equidade.

  • Ensino Superior completo ;
  • Perfil com foco em BackEnd

  • Experiência com Azure Cloud;
  • Container Apps;
  • Function Apps;

  • Event Hub;
  • Blob Storage;

  • ELK (monitoramento);
  • Elasticsearch;
  • APM;

  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura limpa e/ou arquitetura hexagonal
  • Experiência com SOLID
  • Experiência com Microservices
  • Mensageria (Kafka,RabbitMQ );
  • Git;


Experiências técnicas desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Padrões/design de Software
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e bibliotecas relacionadas, como React Router, Material-UI, ou Styled Components,

title: Salesforce Configuration Specialist
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Salesforce Configuration Specialist to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only) , offering the chance to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


We are seeking a Salesforce Configuration Specialist with strong hands-on experience in complex configurations and data management. This role is focused on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions using declarative tools , with a strong emphasis on Flows, security, and data integrity .


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute advanced Salesforce configurations (Flows, Experience Cloud, automation, custom fields, permissions)
  • Manage data migration and ensure data quality and consistency
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions
  • Troubleshoot configuration and data reconciliation issues
  • Provide training and create user/technical documentation
  • Build reports and dashboards for operational and leadership insights


Required Experience

  • Solid experience with Salesforce administration and configuration (not only certifications)
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • User management (roles, profiles, permission sets, security policies)
  • Data modeling and object relationships
  • Validation rules, formula fields, record types, list views
  • Flows (advanced level) and troubleshooting
  • Experience with SSO/SAML configuration and authentication setup
  • Proficiency in Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, and data quality management
  • Ability to differentiate data vs. configuration issues and replicate scenarios in sandbox environments
  • Experience building reports and dashboards


Preferred Profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience
  • Strong communication skills in English (client-facing environment)
  • Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach
  • Experience in B2B software environments


Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, or ISV development
  • Experience writing technical specifications


Why Join

  • Work on international projects with global clients
  • Exposure to complex, large-scale Salesforce environments
  • Collaborative and technically driven team


If you have a strong configuration background and can operate at depth without relying on code, this role is aligned with your profile.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

description:
QUEM SOMOS


TozziniFreire é um escritório full-service com atuação em 55 áreas do Direito Empresarial. Nosso compromisso com a integridade, a responsabilidade social e diversidade e a inclusão social está expresso em nossa missão e é reforçado diariamente em nosso desempenho.


INOVADORES ATÉ PARA INOVAR

Somos pioneiros no desenvolvimento de um programa de inovação interno, o ThinkFuture, que prepara nossos advogados para as transformações digitais e já é referência jurídica nos assuntos que envolvam tecnologia.


NOSSA ATUAÇÃO

Nossa equipe de contencioso cível estratégico é premiada e reconhecida pelo mercado e pelos principais guias nacionais e internacionais. O time tem vasta experiência nos diferentes setores, incluindo Consumidor, Tech Litigation & Data Privacy, em que assessoramos empresas com grandes relevâncias no mercado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Para nós, a diversidade é peça fundamental do sucesso. Buscamos advogadas (os) Seniores, com inglês fluente e experiência na área do Contencioso Cível Estratégico.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Profissionais com experiência na área do Contencioso Cível Estratégico;
  • Graduação Superior Completa em Direito;
  • OAB Ativa;
  • Inglês Fluente.

title: Preparador de Casos de Imigração Sênior
description:
Estamos contratando um Senior Immigration Document Preparer com experiência comprovada em casos humanitários como VISTO T, VISTO U, VAWA e processos em COURT AMERICANA .

Essa posição é para profissionais que já trabalham com imigração , entendem a estrutura dos casos e conseguem preparar processos com alto nível de organização, precisão e responsabilidade.

Se você ainda está aprendendo ou nunca trabalhou diretamente com esses tipos de caso, essa vaga não é para você.

Responsabilidades

• Preparação completa de casos de imigração

• Organização e revisão de documentos

• Montagem de pacotes de aplicação

• Suporte à equipe jurídica

• Controle de prazos e deadlines

• Garantir consistência e precisão nos processos


Casos com os quais você irá trabalhar

• T Visa

• U Visa

• VAWA

• Asylum

• Immigration Court cases


Requisitos obrigatórios

• Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência REAL com imigração americana

• Experiência direta com T Visa, U Visa, VAWA, Asylum ou Court (Sabe o que são?)

• Perfil extremamente organizado e atento a detalhes

• Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos e grande volume de documentos

• Profissional proativo e focado em solução de problemas


Diferenciais

• Experiência prévia em law firm de imigração

• Conhecimento de processos em Immigration Court

• Experiência preparando casos humanitários complexos


Formato

Remote (Home Office)


Remuneração

Entre R$2.000 a R$6.000

(de acordo com experiência e performance)


Importante

Para se candidatar, inclua na aplicação:

1️⃣ Quantos anos você trabalha com imigração

2️⃣ Quais desses casos você já preparou:

T Visa / U Visa / VAWA / Asylum / Court

3️⃣ Em qual escritório ou empresa você adquiriu essa experiência

Aplicações sem essas informações serão desconsideradas automaticamente.

title: Junior Data Engineer – Azure Databricks / Python / Spark
description:
Role: Data Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term (Through Dec 2026)

Work Schedule : 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: 8am - 5pm CST

Location : 100% Remote


We are seeking a Junior Data Engineer with experience in Azure Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark to build and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions. The role involves developing ETL/ELT pipelines, optimizing data processing, and supporting cloud-based data platforms in an Azure environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Business Analyst (BA)
description:
I am reaching out because we are in need of a new Business Analyst (BA) resource for our team, and I would like to request your support. Below are the details of the profile we are seeking:


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) to join our team and support initiatives related to our Core Banking systems. This professional will act as a key bridge between business and technology, ensuring clarity of requirements, alignment across teams, and effective delivery of solutions in an Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support Agile ceremonies, including:
  • Daily Scrum (when necessary)
  • Backlog Refinement
  • Sprint Planning
  • Sprint Review
  • Sprint Retrospective (as observer or contributor)
  • Conduct requirements gathering and process analysis
  • Prepare and maintain the product backlog
  • Organize and manage dependencies across teams
  • Validate deliverables to ensure alignment with business needs
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders
  • Leverage JIRA for tracking, documentation, and workflow management

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Experience with Core Banking systems, including:
  • DDA Accounts
  • Savings Accounts
  • Money Market Accounts
  • Certificates of Deposit (CD)
  • Hands-on experience working in Agile teams
  • Strong knowledge of banking processes and system integration
  • Proven experience with:
  • Requirements gathering
  • Backlog preparation and refinement
  • Dependency management
  • Delivery validation
  • Proficiency with JIRA

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with JHA (Jack Henry & Associates) environment

title: Analista de dados
description:
Analista Qualidade de Software - PL/SR


Conhecimentos obrigatórios

  • Ambiente Cloud (AWS)
  • Contato prévio com AWS Glue, Athena e S3
  • Não é necessário domínio avançado, mas é importante já ter vivenciado ambientes em nuvem
  • Python para análise e manipulação de dados

Conhecimentos importantes

  • SQL Server
  • Experiência com procedures, funções e views
  • Sustentação de projetos existentes
  • Capacidade de analisar e debugar scripts já desenvolvidos

  • SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
  • Ferramentas de Data Visualization
  • Utilizamos AWS QuickSight , porém experiência prévia com Power BI, Tableau ou ferramentas similares também é considerada válida

title: Desenvolvedor Java/ Springboot - Sênior
description:
Pessoa desenvolvedora Backend Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java.
  • Conhecimento do framework SpringBoot e suas principais bibliotecas e módulos (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring MVC, etc).
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e noSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com controle de versão, preferencialmente Git.



Você pode se destacar se:

  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e em servidores de aplicação leve.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer


Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.



Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio.
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia.
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.



Requisitos:


  • Possuir graduação completa.
  • Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento.
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento.
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator
description:
Job Title: Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator

Location: Brazil (Remote)


Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator with 6+ years of experience and strong understanding of EBS R12.2 architecture .


Responsibilities:

  • Oracle WebLogic software installation and maintenance (11.x, 12.x, 14.x)
  • Installing WebLogic patches, service packs, and applying utilities like WebLogic.Admin, WebLogic.Deployer
  • WebLogic application server administration, performance monitoring, and tuning
  • Thread dump and heap dump analysis
  • Configuring LDAP and security realms (basic)
  • Developing automation scripts and integrating with HTTP servers
  • Troubleshooting JAR, EAR, WAR files
  • Understanding of EBS with 2 DB Rack System, EXADATA & ASM
  • EBS patching using ADOP (R12.2), CPU patching on DB/EBS/Tech stack
  • Cloning (Oracle DB 19c and EBS R12.2)
  • Renewing SSL and other trusted certificates on EBS
  • Understanding WebLogic server and applying patches
  • Experience with Oracle Multitenant DB architecture (19c), DR (Data Guard – Physical Standby), RMAN and DB restore
  • Shell scripting and routine Oracle Apps DBA activities


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in middleware administration , WebLogic, and Oracle Apps DBA tasks

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Java - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end para atuar em parceria com uma grande varejista.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Projetar e construir serviços utilizando a linguagem Java;

• Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para definir, projetar e entregar novos recursos;

• Acompanhar todo o ciclo de vida dos serviços (conceito, projeto, testes, lançamento e suporte);

• Assegurar que aplicativos novos e antigos satisfaçam aos padrões de qualidade;

• Realizar testes unitários de código quanto à robustez, incluindo casos extremos, usabilidade, acessibilidade e confiabilidade geral;

• Descobrir, avaliar e implementar continuamente novas tecnologias para maximizar a eficiência de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos e qualificações


Hard Skill:


• Arquitetura baseada em micro serviços;

• Metodologias Ágeis de Projetos (Scrum / Kanban);

• Java;

• Stack Spring;

• Testes Unitários e de Integração;

• Git e Gitflow;

• Containers baseados Docker;

• Jenkins;

• AWS: API Gateway, Lambda, Fargate, ECS, RDS, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, Elasticache (Redis).


Soft Skill:


• Ser comprometido e engajado na proposição e evolução das soluções tanto do ponto de vista técnico, do negócio e da experiência oferecida ao usuário.

• Ter boa capacidade de interação e comunicação com pessoas técnicas e não técnicas.

• Ter alto nível de proatividade.


Seria legal se você tivesse:


• Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis;

• Experiência com desenvolvimento baseado em event sourcing;

• Conhecimento em NodeJS/Python/Golang/Groovy;

title: Analista de infraestrutura Junior - Linux
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Responsável por fornecer suporte técnico na configuração, manutenção e monitoramento de servidores, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos sistemas e recursos de infraestrutura.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Instala servidores físicos ou virtuais, garantindo a configuração adequada dos sistemas operacionais e softwares relacionados;
  • Suporte de serviços de rede essenciais nos servidores, como DHCP, DNS, Controladores de Domínios, servidores de arquivos e impressão, para garantir a conectividade e a disponibilidade dos recursos de rede;
  • Realiza a manutenção regular dos servidores, aplicando atualizações de segurança, patches e correções de bugs para garantir a estabilidade e a segurança dos sistemas.
  • Presta suporte técnico aos usuários, solucionando problemas relacionados aos servidores, respondendo a solicitações de suporte e fornecendo orientações sobre o uso adequado dos recursos disponíveis;
  • Colabora em projetos de infraestrutura de servidores, auxiliando na implementação de novas tecnologias, migrações ou atualizações de servidores;

title: Data Engineer Revenue Management
description:
Data Engineer Revenue Management Remote (send your resume in English)


A Iron Mountain está em busca de um Data Engineer Revenue Management motivado(a) e com fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês para se juntar à nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management (Gestão de Receita Global).

Neste cargo, você será responsável por projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis para garantir dados limpos e acessíveis, transformando dados brutos em insights que impulsionam a melhor segmentação de clientes.

Você fará parte de uma equipe de alto impacto dedicada a direcionar a estratégia de preços global para atingir nossas metas de receita e lucro, exigindo coordenação entre as regiões da América do Norte, Europa e América Latina.


O Que Você Fará

  • Desenvolver Arquiteturas de Dados Escaláveis: Projetar e manter pipelines de Extraction, Transformation, and Loading (Extração, Transformação e Carregamento - ETL) integrando dados de sistemas operacionais globais usando tecnologias Amazon Web Services (AWS) e Structured Query Language (SQL).
  • Otimizar Processos e Automação: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos internos, redesenhando a infraestrutura para maior escalabilidade e automatizando processos manuais para fornecer conjuntos de dados selecionados para análises e painéis operacionais.
  • Garantir a Excelência Operacional e Governança: Monitorar o desempenho e a qualidade dos pipelines, implementando testes automatizados e padrões de governança de dados alinhados às políticas de segurança da informação da empresa.


O candidato ideal terá:

  • fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês
  • 3 a 5 anos ou mais de experiência em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines em ambientes corporativos de grande escala.
  • Sólido conhecimento técnico em modelagem de dados, Structured Query Language (SQL) e proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python ou Scala.
  • Capacidade comprovada em processamento de dados distribuídos (ex: Spark) e no uso de plataformas em nuvem para extração e carregamento de conjuntos de dados complexos.
  • Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.


O Que Oferecemos (Benefícios)

  • Localização: Opções de trabalho remoto ou híbrido para apoiar o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar: Programa de férias e dias de folga remunerados.
  • Segurança e Futuro: Planos abrangentes de saúde, bem-estar e previdência privada.
  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Oportunidades de aprendizado constante e crescimento profissional em uma organização líder global.


Pronto para ajudar a proteger e desbloquear o valor da informação? Candidate-se hoje mesmo para integrar nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management e construir as bases de dados do futuro!

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sr (Java | Cloud | Angular)
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent?


Conhecimento técnico:


  • Java (Liberty+JAX-RS ou Spring Boot);
  • Microserviços (REST, SOAP);
  • Design patterns e integração via eventos/filas;
  • Hexagonal;
  • Mensageria;
  • Bancos SQL e NoSQL;
  • Ferramentas DevOps (Git, Maven, ArgoCD);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum);
  • Angular.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenho de soluções técnicas: Criar soluções eficientes e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio;
  • Arquitetura Hexagonal: Implementar e aplicar para garantir flexibilidade e escalabilidade;
  • Código limpo e manutenível: Seguir princípios de Clean Code;
  • Testes automatizados: Garantir cobertura com JUnit/Mockito;
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs: Criar APIs REST e assíncronas de alta performance;
  • Mensageria: Trabalhar com Service Bus e Kafka;
  • Cloud Azure: Experiência com Azure Functions e Azure Service Bus;
  • Versionamento: Utilizar Git/GitHub com GitFlow;
  • Qualidade e segurança: Usar SonarQube e Fortify;
  • Banco de dados: SQL (DB2/SQLServer) e NoSQL (MongoDB/Atlas).



Formato de Trabalho


Remoto.


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Analista de Suporte AMS
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa Great Place to Work com a melhor solução para comércio exterior do mercado? Confira agora as responsabilidades e os requisitos para a vaga.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Atender e apoiar clientes na utilização do sistema, garantindo uma experiência eficiente e clara;
  • Realizar gestão de chamados, assegurando priorização adequada e cumprimento de SLAs.
  • Investigar e solucionar dúvidas, erros e problemas relacionados ao uso do sistema;
  • Participar de reuniões e acompanhamentos periódicos com clientes;
  • Colaborar com outras áreas internas (desenvolvimento, QA, produto) para garantir a resolução eficiente dos chamados;
  • Documentar atendimentos e contribuir com a melhoria dos processos de suporte;
  • Executar testes de validação e regressão em novas versões do sistema;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e reportá-las de forma estruturada;
  • Abrir e acompanhar backlogs e bugs junto às áreas responsáveis.
  • Realizar configurações de rotinas e parametrizações do sistema conforme necessidade do cliente.
  • Ajustar relatórios e auxiliar usuários na correta utilização das funcionalidades.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino superior (concluído ou em andamento) ou técnico nas áreas de, Comércio Exterior, Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente, especialmente em ambiente técnico ou corporativo;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade analítica e habilidade para lidar com problemas de forma estruturada;



DESEJÁVEL

  • Experiência prévia com suporte a software ou suporte AMS;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de despacho aduaneiro, incluindo rotinas de importação e exportação;
  • Conhecimentos em MySQL ou SQL Server para consultas e análises básicas;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de Comércio Exterior ou ERPs será um diferencial.




Acreditamos em construir juntos , com respeito, inovação, bem-estar e, acima de tudo, cuidado mútuo .


Benefícios pensados em você:

  • Cartão VR/VA – iFood Benefícios pra você se alimentar do seu jeitinho;
  • Cartão Cultura – também no iFood, ideal pra curtir aquele cinema no fim de semana;
  • Gympass – corpo em movimento, mente em equilíbrio ainda com a possibilidade de incluir quem você ama;
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed – qualidade com abrangência nacional;
  • Plano Odontológico Dental Uni – sorrisos bem cuidados;
  • Seguro de Vida – proteção para você e sua família;
  • Convênio com Farma SESI – descontos em medicamentos e serviços;
  • Parcerias Educacionais – descontos em instituições de ensino, como SESI São Paulo, UNESC e SATC;
  • Escolas de idiomas – parceria com Yazigi e Open English;
  • Televita – sessões de psicoterapias de forma gratuita;
  • Mente em foco - parceria com psicólogos da região;
  • Kit Maternidade/Paternidade cheio de carinho.


Detalhes que só o jeito Narwal tem:

  • Fruit Time – frutas fresquinhas todos os dias no nosso recife;
  • Café, chá e cookies sempre por perto;
  • Biblioteca Narwal – acervo físico e online pra você se inspirar;
  • Day Off de aniversário – comemore sua vida como merece;
  • Yoga Laboral – relaxa o corpo e clareia a mente;
  • Programa Eu Indico – indique talentos e ganhe por isso;
  • Café Narwal – nosso momento de alinhamento semanal com comes, bebes e muita sinergia;
  • Eu Inspiro Esse Lugar Incrível – reconhecimentos mensais, pois aqui você é parte essencial da nossa cultura.





Na Narwal você ajuda a construir o dia a dia de milhões de brasileiros através de uma solução inteligente para comex. Faça parte do nosso recife.
